title: Media Library: Upload, Organize and Reuse Files | Orchard Core
description:
Photos, PDFs and downloads end up scattered across pages, and it gets hard to know what a site holds.

The Media module gives the site one library in the admin. You upload files, organize them in folders, rename, move, copy and delete them, and pick them from content, such as the Banner Image field of an Article.

In this video:
• What the library is
• A tour of the library
• Upload files
• Organize with folders
• Work with files
• Find files
• Reuse a file in content
• Optional features
